dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: A perfectly good Jade Chamber... Gone, just like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing over here?

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. I... Well, I'm currently thinking about how to clear up the fragments of the Jade Chamber currently floating on the ocean surface...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: You recall that it was completely destroyed when it crashed, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Those fragments ended up floating on the ocean, with some larger pieces even blocking the path of passing ships...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: The Ministry of Civil Affairs organized a cleanup, which got rid of all the larger pieces.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: But as for those smaller bits of flotsam... Clear them out one day, and more come floating in the next...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: While they're not that much of a problem, the Ministry's stance is that we should clean them up all the same. I'm currently thinking about how this can be done.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Our sergeant said that I could look for some people to help out, but who would want to do this job anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: I mean, um, unless you... Well, are you willing to help me with the cleanup? You might even be able to keep some of the useful items you pick up.

response.speaker: Kun
response.text: Thanks, you're a big help. I'm afraid that I'm not a particularly good swimmer...

response.speaker: Kun
response.text: Honestly, I don't know myself. But given that this is the Jade Chamber, I'm sure that something eye-catching will turn up.
